text: Kannada p.232 prints Pā. 3-685 (īṣākṣādīnāṃ chandasi prakṛtibhāvo vaktavyaḥ); applied as printed in the English (was Pā. Sū. 6-1-[128] vārttika)

Kannada p.447 prints Ṛ. Saṃ. 5-45-55 (no such Ṛk; sūkta 5-45 has 11 Ṛks); applied as printed in the English (was 5-[?]-[?])
Kannada p.465 prints Ṛ. Saṃ. 18-39-12 (no Maṇḍala 18; the verse yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva is not at 18-39-12); applied as printed in the English (was 10-39-12 [?])
Kannada p.549 prints Pā. Sū. 8-2-72 for hrasvād aṅgāt, p.547 prints 8-2-27; each applied as printed in the English (was 8-2-72 / 8-3-12 [?])
